title: Cookie policy
description: Which cookies GizaTourism.com and its partners use, and how to control them.
body_html:
Cookies are small text files a website stores in your browser. This page lists the kinds used on GizaTourism.com.

Analytics cookies

Google Analytics 4 sets cookies (named _ga and _ga_*) to count visits and see which pages are read. You can block them with the Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on.

Advertising cookies

Google and other third-party vendors use cookies to serve ads based on your prior visits to this site and other sites. You can turn off personalized ads at Google Ads Settings or www.aboutads.info.

Affiliate cookies

If you click a booking link, the partner (GetYourGuide, Viator and Booking.com) may set a cookie so a booking can be credited to us.

Controlling cookies

Every browser lets you block or delete cookies in its settings. Blocking them won't stop you reading the site. More detail is in our privacy policy.
